known_scope_limits: No real-data execution or scientific performance claims
Independent coordinate links are candidate hypotheses
SC donor SD is descriptive spread, not a confidence interval
Patient HC3 inference is descriptive association; current-core candidate selection is exploratory
Current core CLI verification substitutes a deterministic tiny graph/model; no real checkpoint inference was run
Drug attribution uses actual frozen forward passes but explains association strength, not sensitivity direction or pharmacological causality.
ENCODE functional bridges remain RBP depletion evidence; no lncRNA perturbation or external-validation claim.
RBNS sequence scores are predictions; the separate typed relation artifact has not entered a real graph/training run.
C11 current-C three-arm preparation, actual training loader and frozen export are code-implemented and fixture-verified; no real expansion/training/effect comparison was run.
The synthetic comparison uses fixture authority metadata and tiny tensors; it does not attest real patient data, graph quality or scientific accuracy.
C01, C05, C08 and C13-C16 remain unfinished. C09 functional evidence now has an actual C12 rule-summary and release consumer.
C12 audit independently recomputes aggregation with SQL but shares raw-source normalization adapters; it is not biological external validation.

C12 tests exercise actual native producers, audit/query, fusion preparation and public serializers with synthetic files and fixed coefficients only; no optimizer or scientific production analysis was run.
Historical native event artifacts cannot recover discarded context/review fields; obtaining those fields requires rematerializing the upstream events from raw sources.
case_count_policy: Deduplicate by module and exact parameterized case name; replace the older unparameterized signed-SC runner case with the later five parameterized cases. Only selected passing suites count.
